clips.text: Making a pixel reel starts with one sentence. You tell Claude what you'd like explained.
It can be a link to an article. A letter you've been sent. Or just a question, like, how does a mortgage work.
Type it into the box on the make page, and we'll write out the words to give to Claude. Then you copy them across.
Claude does the rest. And if you haven't added Pixel Reel to Claude yet, do that first. It only takes a minute.
